Verification sends a test query “podcast” and authentication headers to api.podcastindex.org. A failed or cancelled replacement keeps your previous key. Fields are cleared after submission; re-enter them to retry.

Your entered key and secret stay out of settings backups and sync. Android encrypts the entered API secret with Keystore; Windows protects the secrets file with user-bound DPAPI. macOS and Linux use a file protected by 0600 permissions, without encryption. Your API key identifier is also stored unencrypted in local credential metadata.
